title.name: Press, personal brand and building in public

overview.description: When press matters — recruiting, fundraising, customers — and when it is a distraction dressed as progress.
objectives: Decide whether you need press at all this quarter
Pitch a journalist without a press release
Build in public without becoming a content creator
prerequisites: Explaining science to people who are not scientists

steps.intro: When press matters — recruiting, fundraising, customers — and when it is a distraction dressed as progress.
instructions: Name what press would unlock. If you cannot, skip this module.
Identify three journalists who have covered your specific area, not your sector.
Send one, one paragraph, with a specific reason it is interesting now.
